camel_example: aliyun ccc CreateInstance --region cn-hangzhou --Description '测试' --DirectoryId 1028571882648254 --DomainName cctest --PhoneNumbers.1 'example-string' --UserObject.1 'example-string' --PhoneNumber 010xxxx8557 --StorageMaxDays 30 --StorageMaxSize 1024 --AdminRamId.1 'example-string' --Name '云呼测试'
description_en: Calls CreateInstance to create a call center instance
description_zh: 调用CreateInstance新增呼叫中心实例
kebab_example: aliyun ccc create-instance --name '云呼测试' --description '测试' --domain-name cctest --storage-max-days 30 --storage-max-size 1024 --directory-id 1028571882648254 --phone-number 010xxxx8557 --admin-ram-id example-string --phone-numbers example-string --user-object example-string --api-version 2017-07-05 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en: The name of the call center instance to create. The name must be unique within the account
parameters.help_zh: 待创建的呼叫中心实例的名称，账号下唯一
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the call center instance to create
parameters.help_zh: 待创建的呼叫中心实例的简单描述
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The second-level domain name of the call center instance to create. The domain name must be globally unique
parameters.help_zh: 待创建的呼叫中心实例的二级域名，全局唯一
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of days that recording files can be stored
parameters.help_zh: 录音文件最多存贮天数
parameters.name: storage_max_days

parameters.help_en: The maximum storage capacity for recording files. Unit: GB
parameters.help_zh: 录音文件最多存贮容量，单位GB
parameters.name: storage_max_size

parameters.help_en: The directory service ID, which is the Alibaba Cloud account ID
parameters.name: directory_id

parameters.help_en: The phone number used by the call center for external services
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫中心对外服务的电话号码
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.help_en: The list of administrator IDs for the call center instance to create. If this parameter is not specified, the user who performs the creation operation is designated as the call center administrator by default
parameters.help_zh: 待创建的呼叫中心实例管理员ID列表，如果不指定，则默认指定当前执行创建操作的用户为呼叫中心管理员
parameters.name: admin_ram_id

parameters.help_en: The list of phone numbers to add to the call center
parameters.help_zh: 需要添加到呼叫中心的号码列表
parameters.name: phone_numbers

parameters.help_en: Creates multiple users when creating the call center
parameters.help_zh: 创建呼叫中心的同时创建多个用户
parameters.name: user_object
